findings.description: The KMS key used for the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the key material is disabled (default false). Long-lived static key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for audit log data.

No policy argument is defined, so AWS applies the default key policy that delegates full kms:* permissions to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account with appropriate IAM permissions to use or administer the key that protects audit logs. An explicit least-privilege key policy should restrict decrypt/administer rights to specific principals.
